nodes.label: Decision 1: Problem framing — build the simplest thing
Decision 3: Chrome browser extension as distribution model
Decision 5: Hybrid LLM strategy (Ollama default, Anthropic fallback)
Decision 7: Flat JSON profile storage (plain text v1)
Decision 10: UI design system (Minimal Single Column + Micro-interactions)
Decision 11: Verification target (>=85% fill, zero wrong)
Always confirm before filling (anti-pattern: auto-fill without confirmation)
MV3 service workers terminate when idle
No SSE/streaming response interception in MV3
Ollama Cloud does not support structured outputs
React value setter trick (dispatch input + change events)
chrome.runtime.onMessage must return true for async sendResponse
Manual test set (Seek, MyGov, Substack, Shopify, awkward labels)
Form scanner unit tests with HTML fixtures
Rejected: Multi-agent orchestration (LangGraph, agent swarms)
